snippet.title: inKONBINI - Official Gameplay Trailer | ID@Xbox April 2026 Showcase
snippet.description: inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories. The new inKONBINI trailer showcases gameplay, including meeting customers, stocking supplies, and more. inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories will be available on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, and PC on April 30, 2026. It is also coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch.
